name: refmind
description: Visual bookmark & site intelligence desktop app for mymind built with Electrobun v2

scripts.dev: bun run build:view && bunx electrobun dev
scripts.build: bun run build:view && bunx electrobun build
scripts.build:canary: bun run build:view && bunx electrobun build --env=canary
scripts.build:stable: bun run build:view && bunx electrobun build --env=stable
